name: What should I ask a custom home builder during the first meeting?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask before hiring a custom home builder?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask before hiring a custom home builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first meeting should reveal whether the builder is a good fit for the project type, site conditions, and communication style. Homeowners should ask about recent similar projects, local permit experience, how budgets are built, how allowances are handled, and what happens when plans or site conditions change. It is also important to learn who will be on-site, how often progress updates are given, and how decisions move through the team. For custom homes, design coordination matters just as much as field execution, so ask how the builder works with architects and engineers to keep the project aligned. The right builder should be able to explain their process clearly, not just sell the finished result. A good first meeting should leave the owner with a better understanding of risk, sequence, and accountability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about recent similar projects, permit experience, budget controls, allowances, change orders, schedule management, and who will supervise the job daily. Also ask how the builder handles design coordination and unexpected site conditions. The goal is to understand both quality and communication before signing anything.
